protocol: Full input replay except explicitly labelled 600-second probes; 5Hz held-out pose disagreement, 50Hz coverage, independent capture window. Prefix probes use explicit 600-second bounds and the same pre-206.667-second fit. Per-variant support counts are retained; expanding coverage changes the evaluated sample set.

trials.name: Reject every redundant scene, including complete full-ring refreshes
trials.decision: Rejected: long BS 2.0 position tails and availability regressed.

trials.name: Preserve and hard-lock existing reference pose, four short captures
trials.decision: Locking from startup is mixed and worsens BS 1.0 position. Threshold 32 does not activate in these four captures; all four native streams then equal the baseline.

trials.name: Explicit reset near runtime 250 seconds, first 600 seconds of BS 2.0
trials.decision: Neither prototype adopted. Cached retry restores updates sooner but can reuse pre-movement calibration rays. Clearing all cache does not improve recovery here and changes the world frame; fixed pre-reset alignment records the discontinuity, not pure tracking accuracy.
